description.value:
Cost 1 Vitae

Duration 1 minute

You can move through a space as narrow as one foot wide without Squeezing, and you gain a +2 circumstance bonus to Escape and to Acrobatics checks to Squeeze. While Boneless, your unarmed attacks deal one fewer damage die — nothing in you is braced against anything.

cinderfall.incomplete: The +2 circumstance Escape/Squeeze bonus is buildable in isolation but is gated behind an activation+duration with no companion effect file: This is an activated, duration-limited self-buff shaped exactly like this corpus's own 13 companion-effect pairs (apex-draught -> apex-draught-effect, etc.) and the real pf2e precedent for that shape (pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/equipment/juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json + equipment-effects/effect-juggernaut-mutagen-lesser.json; feats/class/monk/level-1/gorilla-stance.json + feat-effects/stance-gorilla-stance.json) -- in both, the triggering card's rules: [] is correct and the numeric payload lives on a separate companion Effect item the triggering card GrantItems into. No matching *-effect.json companion exists for this card, so the mechanism is real but the sibling file it would need is missing -- a card-authoring gap, not an engine limitation. "Move through a 1-foot space without Squeezing" and "unarmed attacks deal one fewer damage die" are both unhookable: no selector waives the Squeeze requirement (same shape as the confirmed-absent difficult-terrain-ignoring precedent, Determined Dash, extended here), and no rule element downgrades an actor's own unarmed damage die.
